example.title: Cannery Row conveyor crossover over the street (white lattice bridge)
example.place: Cannery Row, Monterey, Monterey County, CA

brief: An enclosed conveyor crossover bridging the waterfront street between a cannery and its warehouse: a boxy white-painted timber truss enclosure with diagonal lattice sides and a flat roof, carried on the buildings at each end some 6 m above the road, now a pedestrian bridge. One photo. Older than 1970: cannery crossovers are pre-war. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
